## Summary / 摘要

Fixes the confirmed P2-OBS01 from PR #29 on top of the exact tested product SHA `0cd1278468d0471b862e16ca4ffcac41aead5e6d`.

- Excludes the V3 admin navigation action from the global trusted-click dirty heuristic. Opening the admin/backup area is navigation, not a business-data edit.
- Replaces the silent S4 download guard return with explicit user-visible status for unavailable, busy, blocked, or dirty states.
- Adds a regression step to the existing real-browser full-backup/restore acceptance test: click the top admin navigation action, reopen the backup area normally, then verify a real S4 ZIP download.

## Validation / 验证

- CI and browser tests have **not yet been run for this candidate**. Await the exact-HEAD GitHub Actions results.
- Independent Codex Cloud verification is required after CI succeeds.
- Keep PR #24 and PR #29 open pending review and independent validation.

## Safety boundary / 安全边界

No main changes, no merges, no real-user data. Existing S4 archive/restore logic is otherwise unchanged. This PR is Draft until CI and independent acceptance complete.

The known admin→S4 failure did not recur in 24 rapid RFQ-return attempts. A genuine unsaved edit is correctly blocked, but with Project operations collapsed and the header scrolled above the viewport, its explanation is not currently visible. prs.body:
## 结论 / Verdict

**准确产品 SHA：`a0edd9a753733c738360fc437d0a3ee4a29144e4`**。证据提交 `d924cd791fed300d0262792b101d883be5e08a22`。

**P3-S4-01 视觉/交互 PASS；备份与关键采购业务 PASS（限实际执行范围）。19 PASS /0 FAIL /4 NOT TESTED。** 本轮没有新的已确认产品缺陷，不等于全产品认证或批准合并。

[PR #31](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/pull/31) 的折叠项目区+页面滚动原场景，在1366×768、1024×768、1600×900均复验：按钮旁整段阻止原因位于当前视口，无备份API；真实SQLite自动保存成功后旧提示清除、按钮解禁、实际ZIP下载成功。保存进行中/失败、实际停止服务、真实双窗口后端409均保留已有警告，数据保护保持。

P3 visibility and stale-warning clearing pass at all three resolutions. Pending/failed saves, a real server outage and an actual backend revision conflict retain established warnings; only a successful save or safe saved-record reload resolves them.

## 执行与证据 / Execution and evidence

- 两条CI先核验：[Push39369245980](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39369245980)、[PR39369250226](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39369250226)，Windows/Linux均SUCCESS，各44浏览器场景通过。独立直接运行候选HEAD及HTTP字节匹配的正式M1-Lite，未用CI合成merge或PR23原型。
- 全新隔离SQLite、真实云端Chromium、虚构采购数据。完整GUI场景与只读落盘核对，非仅代码判断或CI复跑。
- OBS原时序24/24真实快速下载，意外超时0；admin→backup可信点击86.2–364.9ms，不加固定后置等待。
- 28个S4 ZIP：初次业务1+快速24+提示清除后3；全量CRC、manifest SHA、SQLite当前/完整历史行及PDF核验，311项PASS。两个空目录恢复和两个非空安全拒绝PASS。
- 采购回归：并列20/20单项/批量、8/12高价理由、人工待核对、新报价复核、V1→V2历史锁定、保存/F5/RFQ切换/实际重启、图纸、CSV/XLSX及供应商包。实际合计638/692→638/717，人工662，无报价不计零；37项文件校验PASS。
- 一条原始REAL409检查前置条件错过、两次独立驱动准备/探针错误完整保留；真实冲突闸门补验通过。没有删除失败或冒称所有原始断言通过。
- NOT TESTED：Windows本机、桌面Excel重算打印、生产磁盘断电/全负载并发、完整PR23像素认证/所有业务组合。
